title: Learned surface fingerprints guide de novo design of protein binders
summary: A geometric deep-learning framework (MaSIF) generates fingerprints of protein surface geometry and chemistry that were used to computationally design de novo binders to SARS-CoV-2 spike, PD-1, PD-L1 and CTLA-4. Some designs were experimentally optimized and others generated purely in silico, reaching nanomolar affinity, with structural and mutational characterization showing accurate predictions.
ai_technology: MaSIF geometric deep-learning framework on protein surface fingerprints
organization: Ecole Polytechnique Federale de Lausanne; Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics; Monte Rosa Therapeutics

evidence.ai_role: Surface-fingerprint deep learning drove the computational design of binders to four targets.
